[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
William was born in 1836. He was the son of [[Glasgow-3543|David Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-3544|Agnes Glasgow]]. He passed away in 1870.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-3543]] is assessed at 90% (confident). William Robert Glasgow's baptism on 14 December 1835 at Manchester Cathedral is indexed (two copies of one entry) to David Glasgow and Agnes, the couple of David [[Glasgow-3543]] and Agnes [[Glasgow-3544]], who married at Manchester in 1833 and baptised Isabella (1837), Agnes (1839) and David Alfred (1841) there. His exact double forename, 1836 birth estimate and Manchester life fit, and only one David and Agnes Glasgow couple appears in Manchester. The father link rises from 66% to 90% proved.

Index transcript only; the cathedral register is uninspected and his 1870 Chorlton death is not transcribed for parents. No mother change follows.

=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 ===

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-3543]] is assessed at 66% (probable). William Robert’s account assigns David and Agnes and gives a compatible 1836 birth in the Manchester sibling family. The sole held source is a FamilySearch contributed source list, without a parent quotation or household linking him to this David.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Earlier proposed test: Inspect William’s baptism and 1870 death or marriage for father occupation/residence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/sources/MSWL-F9Q https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/sources/MSWL-F9Q]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
